Great food and service. Recommending to everyone in Hue.
Dec 2025 • Family
One of the best restaurants we have been to in the area! The food was amazing and the service impeccable. Loan, amongst with other members of the staff, was so amazing offering impeccable service and being so helpful and accommodating without hovering, providing a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere! She ensured that everything was perfect, even sending one of her teammates on an orange hunt when they have run out of oranges for our orange juice and offering us hot water when the food was spicier than anticipated! Honestly such an amazing experience and the food also looked and tasted amazing, ensuring great value for money. The wait time for the food wasn't very long and we have got our ordered food gradually so we had time to eat everything whilst still hot, unlike other restaurants in the area which would just bring out everything at once. Would recommend!
